quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear on a warm day when we do not need long sleeves?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It often has a fun design on the front.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: You can print almost any picture or color onto a T-shirt.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that makes a happy flip-flap sound as we walk on the sand?
quests.question: Flip-Flops
quests.hint: They make a fun slapping sound as you walk.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: A flip-flop has just one strap, between your big toe and the next.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear so a whole soccer team looks matching during a game?
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: It shows which group someone belongs to.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: Sports teams wear matching uniforms so players are easy to spot.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear under a skirt or dress to keep our legs warm?
quests.question: Tights
quests.hint: They are thinner than leggings.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Ballet dancers often wear tights so their legs can move freely.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that ties with a soft belt around our waist?
quests.question: Bathrobe
quests.hint: It ties closed with a soft belt.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: Most bathrobes tie closed with a soft belt at the waist.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear instead of regular pants, with pockets on the chest too?
quests.question: Overalls
quests.hint: They cover your chest as well as your legs.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: Farmers and painters often wear overalls to protect their clothes underneath.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear to keep the warm sun out of our eyes?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You tip this to say a friendly hello.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: A hat can keep your head warm in winter or shady in summer.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that is knotted neatly just below our collar?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It hangs down the front of a shirt!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: A tie is knotted around the collar and hangs down a dress shirt!

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear when we go outside on a cool morning?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It keeps the wind from making you shiver.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: A jacket is lighter than a coat but still keeps you warm.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear when we splash through puddles or trudge through snow?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They reach up past your ankle.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Sturdy boots are perfect for hiking over rocks and mud.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear instead of jeans when we want something soft and flexible?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are stretchy and hug your legs closely!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: Leggings are so stretchy that they move easily with you!

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear to a birthday party to look extra special?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It can be short or reach all the way to your ankles.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: Dresses come in every color and pattern you can imagine.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear to protect our feet from sharp rocks and hot ground?
quests.question: Shoes
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They have soles that touch the ground.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: People have worn some kind of shoes for over ten thousand years.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear on a hot day when we want to splash and float?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear this to go swimming!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: Swimsuits are made from special fabric that dries quickly after a swim!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear so our trousers do not slip down while we play?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It goes around your waist!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: A belt threads through little loops to keep your pants from slipping!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that has two dark lenses and two little arms?
quests.question: Sunglasses
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They protect your eyes from bright light!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: Sunglasses protect your eyes from strong, bright sunlight!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear on a gray, drizzly, splashy-puddle kind of day?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It keeps rain from soaking your clothes!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: Raincoats are made from special material that water cannot soak through!

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that is soft, loose, and comfortable for sleeping?
quests.question: Pajamas
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You change into these right before a story and sleep.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Changing into pajamas is a cozy signal that bedtime is near.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of our regular clothes, just for pretend play?
quests.question: Costume
quests.hint: Hint: It could turn you into a superhero or a dragon.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: Some costumes are simple, and some have many colorful, sparkly parts.

quests.instruction: What do we wear with a small pocket, just the right size for a coin?
quests.question: Jeans
quests.hint: Hint: They are strong enough for climbing and rough play.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: Most jeans have a tiny pocket meant for holding a coin or a watch.

quests.instruction: What do we wear over our backpack to keep it dry in a sudden rainstorm?
quests.question: Poncho
quests.hint: Hint: It drapes loosely over your shoulders.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: Ponchos have no sleeves or buttons, so they slip on in a second.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that covers our ears completely on a freezing day?
quests.question: Beanie
quests.hint: Hint: It covers your ears completely.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: A warm beanie is perfect for keeping your ears toasty in the cold.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that swishes and rustles a little as we move?
quests.question: Windbreaker
quests.hint: Hint: It is much lighter than a winter coat.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: Runners often wear windbreakers because they are so light and easy to move in.

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of sneakers on a wet, rainy, puddly day?
quests.question: Rain Boots
quests.hint: Hint: They keep your socks completely dry.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: Rain boots are sometimes called 'wellies' in some parts of the world.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear to keep our feet cozy while we walk on cold floors?
quests.question: Slippers
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are soft and worn indoors, not outside!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: Slippers are made soft and cozy just for wearing around the house!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear that buttons up the front but leaves our arms bare?
quests.question: Vest
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It has no sleeves at all!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: A vest has no sleeves, so your arms stay completely free!

quests.instruction: What do we wear to protect our shirt from flour, paint, or splashes?
quests.question: Apron
quests.hint: Hint: It catches spills and splatters before they hit your clothes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: Some aprons have a big pocket in the front, handy for holding a spoon.

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear instead of dress shoes when we want to move fast?
quests.question: Sneakers
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are made for running and jumping!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Sneakers have soft, bouncy soles that make running more comfortable!

quests.instruction: Can you name the item we wear under our pajamas too, every night before bed?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is worn first, under everything else!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Underwear is the very first thing you put on when you get dressed!

quests.instruction: What do we wear instead of picking our own clothes, for school or a team?
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Hint: It usually has the same colors as everyone else's.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: Some schools ask every student to wear the very same uniform.
